settings.heading: It behaves less like a symptom than a circuit

settings.content: Dermatology has moved toward describing lasting flushing as a loop, not an event.

settings.aria_label: Five points arranged in a loop; each lowers the threshold of the next; the fifth is hidden
settings.legend: 1 Vessel tone — how fully vessels close again. 2 Nerve signal — the threshold to react at all. 3 Inflammation — more inputs start it than stop it. 4 Barrier — when thin, it exposes the nerves beneath. 5 — not on the skin. It comes later.

settings.content: Each point lowers the threshold of the next. Treat one and leave four, and the four pull the treated one back.
There’s a fifth. It rarely shows up in a treatment plan. It’s the reason the other four keep resetting.
